capabilities.target: the explicit host-owned plugin install root, selected plugin target, and private transaction directories
capabilities.justification: Checks canonical directory identities and compares complete existing and staged snapshots without following links.

capabilities.target: the selected installed plugin target and private staging tree
capabilities.justification: Enumerates bounded complete trees to reject unexpected, linked, multiply linked, or non-portable entries.

capabilities.target: exclusive lock, staging, and backup directories inside the explicit host-owned plugin install root
capabilities.justification: Reserves same-filesystem private transaction paths before materializing or swapping a plugin snapshot.

capabilities.target: exclusive regular files beneath the private staging directory
capabilities.justification: Writes only bounded defensively copied package bytes and the installer-generated manifest-bound grants file.

capabilities.target: identity-bound lock, staging, and backup directories created by this installer transaction
capabilities.justification: Removes only transaction-owned paths after publication, cancellation, failure, or rollback.

justification: Validates an in-memory plugin snapshot, writes it beneath one explicit host-owned root, and atomically publishes it with same-parent rename. It performs no network, environment, shell, or subprocess access.
